def create_comprehensive_segments(df):
    """
    Create all possible segment combinations from allowed aggregation levels
    to maximize analytical granularity
    """
    segment_columns = []
    
    # Check which aggregation levels are available
    for level in allowed_aggregation_levels:
        if level in df.columns:
            segment_columns.append(level)
    
    if not segment_columns:
        print("No allowed aggregation columns found. Using all non-confidential categorical columns.")
        # Fall back to using categorical columns (excluding confidential ones)
        for col in categorical_cols:
            if col not in confidential_columns and df[col].nunique() <= 20:
                segment_columns.append(col)
    
    print(f"\nUsing these columns for segmentation: {segment_columns}")
    
    # Create all possible segment combinations
    segments = []
    
    if len(segment_columns) == 1:
        # Simple segmentation by single column
        for value in df[segment_columns[0]].unique():
            segment_df = df[df[segment_columns[0]] == value]
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': f"{segment_columns[0]}_{value}",
                    'segment_def': {segment_columns[0]: value},
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    else:
        # Create all combinations of segment columns
        from itertools import product
        
        # Get all unique values for each segment column
        segment_values = []
        for col in segment_columns:
            segment_values.append(df[col].dropna().unique())
        
        # Generate all combinations
        for combo in product(*segment_values):
            # Create filter mask
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
            segment_def = {}
            
            for i, col in enumerate(segment_columns):
                mask = mask & (df[col] == combo[i])
                segment_def[col] = combo[i]
            
            segment_df = df[mask]
            
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                # Create segment ID
                segment_id_parts = [f"{col}_{val}" for col, val in zip(segment_columns, combo)]
                segment_id = "_".join(segment_id_parts)
                
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': segment_id,
                    'segment_def': segment_def,
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    
    return segments, segment_columns

def create_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """Create detailed profile for a segment"""
    
    # Identify numeric columns (non-confidential)
    numeric_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(segment_df[col]) and 
            col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns):
            numeric_cols.append(col)
    
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_df) / len(overall_df) * 100,
        'numeric_metrics': {},
        'key_differences': []
    }
    
    # Calculate numeric metrics
    for col in numeric_cols[:15]:  # Limit to 15 key metrics
        if col in segment_df.columns and col in overall_df.columns:
            seg_mean = segment_df[col].mean()
            overall_mean = overall_df[col].mean()
            
            if pd.notna(seg_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean) and overall_mean != 0:
                diff_pct = (seg_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100
                
                profile['numeric_metrics'][col] = {
                    'segment_mean': round(float(seg_mean), 3),
                    'overall_mean': round(float(overall_mean), 3),
                    'difference_percent': round(float(diff_pct), 2),
                    'segment_std': round(float(segment_df[col].std()), 3),
                    'overall_std': round(float(overall_df[col].std()), 3)
                }
    
    # Identify key categorical differences (non-confidential)
    categorical_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns + numeric_cols and
            segment_df[col].nunique() <= 10):
            categorical_cols.append(col)
    
    for col in categorical_cols[:10]:  # Limit to 10 categoricals
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            # Get value distributions
            seg_dist = segment_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True).head(3)
            overall_dist = overall_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True)
            
            for value, seg_pct in seg_dist.items():
                if value in overall_dist.index:
                    overall_pct = overall_dist[value]
                    diff = seg_pct - overall_pct
                    
                    if abs(diff) > 0.1:  >10% difference
                        profile['key_differences'].append({
                            'attribute': col,
                            'value': value,
                            'segment_pct': round(float(seg_pct * 100), 1),
                            'overall_pct': round(float(overall_pct * 100), 1),
                            'difference_pct': round(float(diff * 100), 1)
                        })
    
    # Sort differences by magnitude
    profile['key_differences'].sort(key=lambda x: abs(x['difference_pct']), reverse=True)
    
    return profile

def create_comprehensive_segments(df):
    """

    to maximize analytical granularity
    """
    segment_columns = []
    
    # Check which aggregation levels are available
    for level in allowed_aggregation_levels:
        if level in df.columns:
            segment_columns.append(level)

        print("No allowed aggregation columns found. Using all non-confidential categorical columns.")
        # Fall back to using categorical columns (excluding confidential ones)
        for col in categorical_cols:
            if col not in confidential_columns and df[col].nunique() <= 20:
                segment_columns.append(col)
    
    print(f"\nUsing these columns for segmentation: {segment_columns}")
    
    # Create all possible segment combinations
    segments = []
    
    if len(segment_columns) == 1:
        # Simple segmentation by single column
        for value in df[segment_columns[0]].unique():
            segment_df = df[df[segment_columns[0]] == value]
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': f"{segment_columns[0]}_{value}",
                    'segment_def': {segment_columns[0]: value},
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    else:
        # Create all combinations of segment columns
        from itertools import product
        
        # Get all unique values for each segment column
        segment_values = []
        for col in segment_columns:
            segment_values.append(df[col].dropna().unique())
        
        # Generate all combinations

            # Create filter mask
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
            segment_def = {}
            
            for i, col in enumerate(segment_columns):

            segment_df = df[mask]
            
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                # Create segment ID
                segment_id_parts = [f"{col}_{val}" for col, val in zip(segment_columns, combo)]
                segment_id = "_".join(segment_id_parts)
                
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': segment_id,
                    'segment_def': segment_def,
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    
    return segments, segment_columns

# Function to create segment profiles
def create_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """Create a comprehensive profile for a segment"""
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'overall_size': len(overall_df),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_df) / len(overall_df) * 100,
        'numeric_profile': {},
        'categorical_profile': {}
    }
    
    # Analyze numeric columns (excluding confidential ones)
    numeric_cols_for_analysis = [col for col in numerical_cols 
                                if col not in confidential_columns 
                                and col not in segment_columns]
    
    for col in numeric_cols_for_analysis[:20]:  # Limit to 20 key metrics
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            segment_mean = segment_df[col].mean()
            overall_mean = overall_df[col].mean()
            
            if pd.notna(segment_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean) and overall_mean != 0:
                diff_percent = (segment_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100
                
                # Only include meaningful differences
                if abs(diff_percent) > 5 or segment_df[col].std() / segment_mean > 0.3:
                    profile['numeric_profile'][col] = {
                        'segment_mean': round(segment_mean, 2),
                        'overall_mean': round(overall_mean, 2),
                        'difference_percent': round(diff_percent, 1),
                        'segment_std': round(segment_df[col].std(), 2),
                        'segment_median': round(segment_df[col].median(), 2)
                    }
    
    # Analyze key categorical columns
    categorical_cols_for_analysis = [col for col in categorical_cols 
                                    if col not in confidential_columns 
                                    and col not in segment_columns
                                    and df[col].nunique() <= 10]
    
    for col in categorical_cols_for_analysis[:10]:  # Limit to 10 key categoricals
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            # Get distribution in segment
            segment_dist = segment_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100
            overall_dist = overall_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100
            
            # Find largest differences
            for value in segment_dist.index:
                if value in overall_dist.index:
                    segment_pct = segment_dist[value]
                    overall_pct = overall_dist[value]
                    diff = segment_pct - overall_pct
                    
                    if abs(diff) > 10:  # Only report substantial differences
                        if col not in profile['categorical_profile']:
                            profile['categorical_profile'][col] = []
                        
                        profile['categorical_profile'][col].append({
                            'value': value,
                            'segment_percentage': round(segment_pct, 1),
                            'overall_percentage': round(overall_pct, 1),
                            'difference': round(diff, 1)
                        })
    
    return profile

# Generate profiles for all segments
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("GENERATING SEGMENT PROFILES")
print("="*80)

segment_profiles = []
for segment in segments:
    if segment['size'] >= 3:  # Only analyze segments with at least 3 members
        profile = create_segment_profile(
            segment['data'], 
            df, 
            segment['segment_id'],
            segment['segment_def']
        )
        segment_profiles.append(profile)

print(f"Generated profiles for {len(segment_profiles)} segments (with at least 3 members)")

                # Only include meaningful differences

                    profile['numeric_profile'][col] = {
                        'segment_mean': round(segment_mean, 2),

            overall_dist = overall_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100
            
            # Find largest differences

                if value in overall_dist.index:
                    segment_pct = segment_dist[value]
                    overall_pct = overall_dist[value]
                    diff = segment_pct - overall_pct

                            'segment_percentage': round(segment_pct, 1),
                            'overall_percentage': round(overall_pct, 1),
                            'difference': round(diff, 1)
                        })
    
    return profile

def create_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """Create detailed profile for a segment"""
    
    # Identify numeric columns (non-confidential)
    numeric_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(segment_df[col]) and 
            col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns):
            numeric_cols.append(col)
    
    profile = {

        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_df) / len(overall_df) * 100,
        'numeric_metrics': {},
        'key_differences': []
    }
    
    # Calculate numeric metrics
    for col in numeric_cols[:15]:  # Limit to 15 key metrics
        if col in segment_df.columns and col in overall_df.columns:
            seg_mean = segment_df[col].mean()
            overall_mean = overall_df[col].mean()
            
            if pd.notna(seg_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean) and overall_mean != 0:
                diff_pct = (seg_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100
                
                profile['numeric_metrics'][col] = {
                    'segment_mean': round(float(seg_mean), 3),
                    'overall_mean': round(float(overall_mean), 3),
                    'difference_percent': round(float(diff_pct), 2),
                    'segment_std': round(float(segment_df[col].std()), 3),
                    'overall_std': round(float(overall_df[col].std()), 3)
                }
    
    # Identify key categorical differences (non-confidential)
    categorical_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns + numeric_cols and
            segment_df[col].nunique() <= 10):
            categorical_cols.append(col)
    
    for col in categorical_cols[:10]:  # Limit to 10 categoricals
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            # Get value distributions
            seg_dist = segment_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True).head(3)
            overall_dist = overall_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True)
            
            for value, seg_pct in seg_dist.items():
                if value in overall_dist.index:
                    overall_pct = overall_dist[value]
                    diff = seg_pct - overall_pct
                    
                    if abs(diff) > 0.1:  >10% difference
                        profile['key_differences'].append({
                            'attribute': col,
                            'value': value,
                            'segment_pct': round(float(seg_pct * 100), 1),
                            'overall_pct': round(float(overall_pct * 100), 1),
                            'difference_pct': round(float(diff * 100), 1)
                        })
    
    # Sort differences by magnitude
    profile['key_differences'].sort(key=lambda x: abs(x['difference_pct']), reverse=True)
    
    return profile

        # Get all unique values for each segment column

        for col in segment_columns:

        # Generate all combinations

            # Create filter mask

            segment_def = {}

                # Create segment ID

                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': segment_id,
                    'segment_def': segment_def,
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })

def create_comprehensive_segments(df):
    """
    Create all possible segment combinations from allowed aggregation levels
    to maximize analytical granularity
    """
    segment_columns = []
    
    # Check which aggregation levels are available
    for level in allowed_aggregation_levels:
        if level in df.columns:
            segment_columns.append(level)
    
    if not segment_columns:
        print("No allowed aggregation columns found. Using all non-confidential categorical columns.")
        # Fall back to using categorical columns (excluding confidential ones)
        for col in categorical_cols:
            if col not in confidential_columns and df[col].nunique() <= 20:
                segment_columns.append(col)
    
    print(f"\nUsing these columns for segmentation: {segment_columns}")
    
    # Create all possible segment combinations
    segments = []
    
    if len(segment_columns) == 1:
        # Simple segmentation by single column
        for value in df[segment_columns[0]].unique():
            segment_df = df[df[segment_columns[0]] == value]
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': f"{segment_columns[0]}_{value}",
                    'segment_def': {segment_columns[0]: value},
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    else:
        # Create all combinations of segment columns
        from itertools import product
        
        # Get all unique values for each segment column
        segment_values = []
        for col in segment_columns:
            segment_values.append(df[col].dropna().unique())
        
        # Generate all combinations
        for combo in product(*segment_values):
            # Create filter mask
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
            segment_def = {}
            
            for i, col in enumerate(segment_columns):
                mask = mask & (df[col] == combo[i])
                segment_def[col] = combo[i]
            
            segment_df = df[mask]
            
            if len(segment_df) > 0:
                # Create segment ID
                segment_id_parts = [f"{col}_{val}" for col, val in zip(segment_columns, combo)]
                segment_id = "_".join(segment_id_parts)
                
                segments.append({
                    'segment_id': segment_id,
                    'segment_def': segment_def,
                    'size': len(segment_df),
                    'data': segment_df
                })
    
    return segments, segment_columns

def analyze_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """
    Create a numeric profile for a segment compared to overall population
    """
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'overall_size': len(overall_df),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_df) / len(overall_df) * 100,
        'numeric_metrics': {},
        'categorical_differences': {}
    }
    
    # Analyze numeric columns (excluding confidential ones)
    numeric_cols_to_analyze = [col for col in numerical_cols if col not in confidential_columns]
    
    for col in numeric_cols_to_analyze[:15]:  # Limit to first 15 for brevity
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            segment_mean = segment_df[col].mean()
            overall_mean = overall_df[col].mean()
            
            if pd.notna(segment_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean):
                diff_percent = ((segment_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100) if overall_mean != 0 else 0
                
                profile['numeric_metrics'][col] = {
                    'segment_mean': segment_mean,
                    'overall_mean': overall_mean,
                    'difference_percent': diff_percent,
                    'segment_std': segment_df[col].std(),
                    'overall_std': overall_df[col].std()
                }
    
    # Analyze key categorical differences
    categorical_cols_to_analyze = [col for col in categorical_cols 
                                  if col not in confidential_columns 
                                  and col not in segment_cols_used]
    
    for col in categorical_cols_to_analyze[:10]:  # Limit to first 10
        if col in segment_df.columns and segment_df[col].nunique() > 0:
            # Get top value in segment
            segment_top = segment_df[col].value_counts().head(1)
            if len(segment_top) > 0:
                top_value = segment_top.index[0]
                top_percent_segment = segment_top.iloc[0] / len(segment_df) * 100
                
                # Compare to overall
                overall_count = overall_df[overall_df[col] == top_value].shape[0]
                top_percent_overall = overall_count / len(overall_df) * 100
                
                diff = top_percent_segment - top_percent_overall
                
                if abs(diff) > 5:  # Only report meaningful differences
                    profile['categorical_differences'][col] = {
                        'top_value_in_segment': top_value,
                        'segment_percentage': top_percent_segment,
                        'overall_percentage': top_percent_overall,
                        'difference': diff
                    }
    
    return profile

def create_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """Create a comprehensive profile for a segment"""
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'overall_size': len(overall_df),

            if pd.notna(segment_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean) and overall_mean != 0:
                diff_percent = (segment_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100
                
                # Only include meaningful differences

                    profile['numeric_profile'][col] = {
                        'segment_mean': round(segment_mean, 2),

                            'overall_percentage': round(overall_pct, 1),
                            'difference': round(diff, 1)

    return profile

def create_segment_profile(segment_df, overall_df, segment_id, segment_def):
    """Create detailed profile for a segment"""
    
    # Identify numeric columns (non-confidential)
    numeric_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(segment_df[col]) and 
            col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns):
            numeric_cols.append(col)
    
    profile = {
        'segment_id': segment_id,
        'segment_definition': segment_def,
        'segment_size': len(segment_df),
        'segment_percentage': len(segment_df) / len(overall_df) * 100,
        'numeric_metrics': {},
        'key_differences': []
    }
    
    # Calculate numeric metrics
    for col in numeric_cols[:15]:  # Limit to 15 key metrics
        if col in segment_df.columns and col in overall_df.columns:
            seg_mean = segment_df[col].mean()
            overall_mean = overall_df[col].mean()
            
            if pd.notna(seg_mean) and pd.notna(overall_mean) and overall_mean != 0:
                diff_pct = (seg_mean - overall_mean) / overall_mean * 100
                
                profile['numeric_metrics'][col] = {
                    'segment_mean': round(float(seg_mean), 3),
                    'overall_mean': round(float(overall_mean), 3),
                    'difference_percent': round(float(diff_pct), 2),
                    'segment_std': round(float(segment_df[col].std()), 3),
                    'overall_std': round(float(overall_df[col].std()), 3)
                }
    
    # Identify key categorical differences (non-confidential)
    categorical_cols = []
    for col in segment_df.columns:
        if (col not in confidential_columns + segment_columns + numeric_cols and
            segment_df[col].nunique() <= 10):
            categorical_cols.append(col)
    
    for col in categorical_cols[:10]:  # Limit to 10 categoricals
        if col in segment_df.columns:
            # Get value distributions
            seg_dist = segment_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True).head(3)
            overall_dist = overall_df[col].value_counts(normalize=True)
            
            for value, seg_pct in seg_dist.items():
                if value in overall_dist.index:
                    overall_pct = overall_dist[value]
                    diff = seg_pct - overall_pct
                    
                    if abs(diff) > 0.1:  >10% difference
                        profile['key_differences'].append({
                            'attribute': col,
                            'value': value,
                            'segment_pct': round(float(seg_pct * 100), 1),
                            'overall_pct': round(float(overall_pct * 100), 1),
                            'difference_pct': round(float(diff * 100), 1)
                        })
    
    # Sort differences by magnitude
    profile['key_differences'].sort(key=lambda x: abs(x['difference_pct']), reverse=True)
    
    return profile
